aboutCommunityBody:
Putnam County is a beautiful stretch of North Central Florida, marked by historic riverfront towns, small farms, and close knit communities that look out for each other. We believe in taking care of one another, protecting our environment, and standing up for what's right. We're proud to call this beautiful place our home.

We're also honest about the challenges we face. Our median household income sits around $47,900, one in five families live below the poverty line, making Putnam one of the poorest counties in Florida. That poverty has thinned out local services and amenities, forcing lower income residents to travel out of town for everything from work to medical care. We can do better. Putnam County's residents deserve reliable public transportation, higher healthcare standards, affordable housing, well paying jobs, and elected officials who actually represent them.

These are the issues that drive PCYD. We're building a practical path for young people, working families, and underrepresented residents to get involved in the Democratic process, and to make a real, lasting impact on the communities we call home
